review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, task keys, repository identity, base commit, and paired-case identity are consistent. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; an unresolved material DEC-001 in B must instead block at decisions before later gates. The exact writable scope covers message formatting, public/internal option declarations, normalization, option filtering, and runtime/type regressions. The supplied source supports treating merge, index, options utilities, hook declarations, and KyInstance declarations as inspection consumers without mandatory edits. Distribution declarations are build outputs, not separately maintained owners, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d file for compile-time verification. The specification requires separate implementation and verification tasks, verification depending on implementation, and both relationships covering every required AC. The allowed agents have matching delivery roles, availability, and supplied active trusted capability claims, including data.change, domain.state, integration.consumer, and verifier-only testing.verification. The configured independent project reviewer satisfies the supplied non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD trimming. The original specification's null releaseInput and preparation checklist are historical preparation state, superseded for this review by the supplied frozen release inputs. Approval concerns the expectation, not execution readiness or task dispatch. I reviewed only the supplied materials, used no candidate outputs or tools, performed no execution or independent digest recomputation, and created no human attestation.
